text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced Stomatitis and Mucocutaneous Ulceration (likely secondary to captopril).

The negative workup for Behçet's disease, autoimmune connective tissue disorders (ANA/ENA), and inflammatory markers, combined with your recent initiation of captopril, strongly suggests a drug-induced etiology for your mucosal ulcers and forearm blisters. Discontinuation of the medication is the primary treatment; please avoid sexual intercourse and contact with broken skin until the lesions heal to prevent transmission of secondary infection.
